summary: Genmab A/S filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Company Announcement No. 49, a Danish MAR Article 19 managerial-transaction disclosure rather than a special situation. Two board members reported open-market share sales on 2026-11-12: Martin Schultz sold 617 shares and Mijke Zachariasse sold 351 shares, each at DKK 3,540.87, executed across NASDAQ Copenhagen, Cboe Europe, Aquis, Turquoise and other venues. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, ownership shift or regulatory clock is involved; the filing merely satisfies PDMR reporting and is incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 registration statements. No deal-terms or risk-arb angle exists; watch only for cumulative insider-sale patterns.
